# routeros_routing_settings (Resource)


## Example Usage
```terraform
resource "routeros_routing_settings" "settings" {
  check_gateway_ping_count    = 2
  check_gateway_ping_interval = "10s"
  check_gateway_ping_timeout  = "1s"
  single_process              = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `check_gateway_ping_count` (Number) How many ICMP ping requests will be sent to the gateway.
- `check_gateway_ping_interval` (String) Interval between ICMP ping requests sent to the gateway.
- `check_gateway_ping_timeout` (String) Timeout for ICMP ping requests sent to the gateway.
- `policy_rules` (String) Comma separated list of routing policy rules that are applied to the packets.
- `single_process` (Boolean) Enable single-process routing protocol management.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
